-- RNGClient: side menu, panels, Index/Inventory cards, equip buttons, settings.
-- Rolling itself lives in RollController.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RNGConfig"))
local ItemIcon = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ItemIcon"))
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local getInventory = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GetInventory")
local equipRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EquipShovel")

local gui = script.Parent
local menu = gui:WaitForChild("LeftMenu")
local panels = gui:WaitForChild("Panels")
local rollFinished = gui:WaitForChild("RollFinished")

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local OUTLINE = Color3.fromRGB(25, 45, 90)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local MAX_EQUIPPED = Config.MaxEquipped or 2

local counts = {}
local equipped = {}
local refresh -- forward declaration

local function tween(obj, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function lighten(c, a) return c:Lerp(WHITE, a) end
local function darken(c, a) return c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), a) end

local function bounce(btn)
	local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not s then return end
	btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1.1}) end)
	btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.08, {Scale = 0.88}) end)
	btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.25, {Scale = 1.1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- PANELS
--------------------------------------------------
local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
blur.Name = "MenuBlur"
blur.Size = 0
blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera

local openPanel = nil
local function showPanel(p)
	local s = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	p.Visible = true
	s.Scale = 0.5
	tween(s, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end
local function hidePanel(p)
	local s = p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 0.5}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In).Completed:Connect(function()
		if openPanel ~= p then p.Visible = false end
	end)
end
local function setBlur(on) tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = on and 16 or 0}) end

local function togglePanel(name)
	local target = panels:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not target then return end
	if openPanel then hidePanel(openPanel) end
	if openPanel == target then
		openPanel = nil
		setBlur(false)
		return
	end
	openPanel = target
	showPanel(target)
	setBlur(true)
end
local function closeAll()
	if openPanel then
		hidePanel(openPanel)
		openPanel = nil
		setBlur(false)
	end
end

-- Frostfall huts use the existing panel state and close behavior.
gui:WaitForChild("VillageOpenMenu").Event:Connect(function(name)
 if name == "Upgrades" then closeAll(); return end
 if name == "Pets" then name = "Inventory" end
 local target = panels:FindFirstChild(name)
 if target and (name == "Inventory" or name == "Shop" or name == "Rebirth") and openPanel ~= target then togglePanel(name) end
end)

local menuButtons = menu:GetChildren()
local settingsCorner = gui:FindFirstChild("SettingsCorner")
if settingsCorner then
	for _, x in ipairs(settingsCorner:GetChildren()) do table.insert(menuButtons, x) end
	-- phones/tablets have the jump button bottom-right, so put Settings top-right there
	if game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled then
		settingsCorner.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		settingsCorner.Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, 0, 14)
	end
end
for _, b in ipairs(menuButtons) do
	if b:IsA("ImageButton") then
		bounce(b)
		b.Activated:Connect(function() togglePanel(b:GetAttribute("Panel")) end)
	end
end
for _, p in ipairs(panels:GetChildren()) do
	local c = p:FindFirstChild("Close")
	if c then
		bounce(c)
		c.Activated:Connect(closeAll)
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- EQUIPPING
--------------------------------------------------
local function copiesEquipped(name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(equipped) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local busy = false
local function sendEquip(action, name)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return equipRemote:InvokeServer(action, name) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		equipped = res
		refresh()
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- CARDS
--------------------------------------------------
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function round(p, s) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(s, 0)}, p) end
local function label(parent, t, props, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, l) end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end
local function smallButton(parent, props, color, text)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = color}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do b[k] = v end
	round(b, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, b)
	local s = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, b)
	label(b, text, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.72)}, 2)
	b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1.08}) end)
	b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
	b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tween(s, 0.08, {Scale = 0.9}) end)
	return b
end

local function card(parent, order, item, count, locked, mode)
	local color = locked and Color3.fromRGB(165, 172, 190) or (Config.Rarities[item.Rarity] or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 190))

	local holder = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, nil)
	local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, holder)
	local shadow = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.78,
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(shadow, 0.16)

	local main = mk("Frame", {Name = "Main", BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(main, 0.16)
	mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(lighten(color, 0.55), color), Rotation = 90}, main)
	local stroke = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 4, Color = darken(color, 0.45), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, main)

	if locked then
		label(main, "?", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.05), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.43)}, 3)
	else
		local iconBox = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.05), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.43)}, main)
		ItemIcon.create(item).Parent = iconBox
	end
	label(main, locked and "???" or item.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.88, 0.19)}, 2.5)

	if mode == "inventory" then
		local on = copiesEquipped(item.Name)
		local canAdd = on < count
		local eb = smallButton(main, {Name = "EquipButton", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.73),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.18)}, canAdd and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90),
			canAdd and "EQUIP" or "EQUIPPED")
		eb.Activated:Connect(function()
			if canAdd then sendEquip("equip", item.Name) end
		end)
		if on > 0 then
			stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 90)
			stroke.Thickness = 6
			local x = smallButton(holder, {Name = "UnequipButton", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.07),
				Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.26)}, Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 80), "X")
			mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, x)
			x.Activated:Connect(function() sendEquip("unequip", item.Name) end)
			if on > 1 then
				label(main, "ON x" .. on, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.36), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.12),
					TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 130)}, 2.5)
			end
		end
	else
		local pill = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = OUTLINE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.74), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.16)}, main)
		round(pill, 1)
		label(pill, "1 in " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(item.Chance), {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.72),
			TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 255, 110)}, false)
	end

	if not locked and item.Chance >= 10 then
		local shine = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Active = false}, main)
		round(shine, 0.16)
		local g = mk("UIGradient", {Rotation = 25, Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0), Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.45),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})}, shine)
		TweenService:Create(g, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.In, -1, false, 1),
			{Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0)}):Play()
	end

	if count and count > 0 then
		local badge = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.38, 0.17)}, holder)
		round(badge, 1)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, badge)
		label(badge, "x" .. count, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, 0.76), TextColor3 = OUTLINE}, false)
	end

	main.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(scale, 0.15, {Scale = 1.04}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
	main.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(scale, 0.15, {Scale = 1}) end)
	holder.Parent = parent
end

local function clear(sc)
	for _, c in ipairs(sc:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end
end

refresh = function()
	local idx = panels.Index.Inner.Content
	local inv = panels.Inventory.Inner.Content
	clear(idx); clear(inv)
	local owned = 0
	for i, item in ipairs(Config.Items) do
		local n = counts[item.Name] or 0
		if n > 0 then
			owned += 1
			card(idx, i, item, n, false, "index")
			card(inv, i, item, n, false, "inventory")
		else
			card(idx, i, item, 0, true, "index")
		end
	end
	if owned == 0 then
		label(inv, "Roll to find your first shovel! ❄", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)}, 3)
	end
	panels.Index.Banner.Title.Text = ("INDEX %d/%d"):format(owned, #Config.Items)
	if panels.Inventory:GetAttribute("Tab") ~= "Pets" then panels.Inventory.Banner.Title.Text = ("INVENTORY %d/%d"):format(#equipped, game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("ShovelSlots") or MAX_EQUIPPED) end
end

rollFinished.Event:Connect(function(_, newCounts, newEquipped)
	if newCounts then counts = newCounts end
	equipped = {}
	for name in (game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(equipped, name) end
	refresh()
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- SETTINGS (shared with RollController via attribute)
--------------------------------------------------
gui:SetAttribute("FastRolls", false)
local tog = panels.Settings.Inner.Content.SkipRow.SkipAnim
local knob = tog.Knob
tog.Activated:Connect(function()
	local on = not gui:GetAttribute("FastRolls")
	gui:SetAttribute("FastRolls", on)
	tween(knob, 0.2, {Position = on and UDim2.fromScale(0.54, 0.5) or UDim2.fromScale(0.06, 0.5)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	tween(tog, 0.2, {BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(80, 210, 110) or Color3.fromRGB(190, 196, 212)})
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- LOAD SAVED DATA
--------------------------------------------------
refresh()
task.spawn(function()
	for _ = 1, 20 do
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return getInventory:InvokeServer() end)
		if ok and type(res) == "table" then
			counts = res.Counts or {}
			equipped = res.Equipped or {}
			break
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
	end
	refresh()
end)

-- admin commands changed our shovels: reload
ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DataRefresh").OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return getInventory:InvokeServer() end)
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then
		counts = res.Counts or {}
		equipped = res.Equipped or {}
		refresh()
	end
end)


-- A rebirth may reduce slots while an earlier roll animation is finishing.
game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EquippedShovels"):Connect(function()
 equipped = {}
 for name in (game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(equipped, name) end
 refresh()
end)

-- PetClient: PETS tab in the inventory + egg hatch animation.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local PetConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetConfig"))
local PetModels = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetModels"))
local EggModels = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EggModels"))
local NumberFormat = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("NumberFormat"))
local hatchedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PetHatched")
local equipRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EquipPet")
local getPets = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GetPets")

local gui = script.Parent
local panel = gui:WaitForChild("Panels"):WaitForChild("Inventory")
local inner = panel:WaitForChild("Inner")
local shovelContent = inner:WaitForChild("Content")
local petContent = inner:WaitForChild("PetContent")
local tabBar = inner:WaitForChild("TabBar")
local title = panel:WaitForChild("Banner"):WaitForChild("Title")

local FONT = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
local OUTLINE = Color3.fromRGB(25, 45, 90)
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local MAX = PetConfig.MaxEquipped

local pets, equipped, discovered = {}, {}, {}
local updateSigns = function() end
local tab = "Shovels"
local refresh

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function round(p, s) mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(s, 0)}, p) end
local function label(parent, t, props, st)
	local l = mk("TextLabel", {Font = FONT, TextScaled = true, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = t}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do l[k] = v end
	if st ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = st or 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, l) end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

-- 3D pet preview inside a frame
local function viewport(parent, petName, props)
	local vp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210),
		LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, nil)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do vp[k] = v end
	local m = PetModels.create(petName)
	m:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	m.Parent = vp
	local _, size = m:GetBoundingBox()
	local dist = math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 1.7 + 1.5
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(dist * 0.45, dist * 0.25, -dist), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = vp
	vp.CurrentCamera = cam
	vp.Parent = parent
	return vp, m
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- TABS
--------------------------------------------------
local function setTab(t)
	tab = t
	panel:SetAttribute("Tab", t)
	shovelContent.Visible = t == "Shovels"
	petContent.Visible = t == "Pets"
	for _, b in ipairs(tabBar:GetChildren()) do
		if b:IsA("TextButton") then
			b.BackgroundColor3 = (b.Name == t .. "Tab") and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 165, 190)
		end
	end
	if t == "Pets" then refresh() else
		-- let RNGClient's title come back
		local n = 0
		for _ in (Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("EquippedShovels") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do n += 1 end
		title.Text = ("INVENTORY %d/%d"):format(n, Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("ShovelSlots") or 2)
	end
end
tabBar:WaitForChild("ShovelsTab").Activated:Connect(function() setTab("Shovels") end)
tabBar:WaitForChild("PetsTab").Activated:Connect(function() setTab("Pets") end)
gui:WaitForChild("VillageOpenMenu").Event:Connect(function(name)
 if name == "Pets" then setTab("Pets") end
end)

--------------------------------------------------
-- PET CARDS
--------------------------------------------------
local function copies(name)
	local n = 0
	for _, e in ipairs(equipped) do if e == name then n += 1 end end
	return n
end

local busy = false
local function send(action, name)
	if busy then return end
	busy = true
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return equipRemote:InvokeServer(action, name) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and type(res) == "table" then equipped = res; refresh() end
end

local function smallButton(parent, props, color, text)
	local b = mk("TextButton", {Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = color}, parent)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do b[k] = v end
	round(b, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, b)
	label(b, text, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.08, 0.14), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.84, 0.72)}, 2)
	return b
end

local function card(order, pet, count)
	local color = PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local holder = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order}, nil)
	local shadow = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.78, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(shadow, 0.16)
	local main = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)}, holder)
	round(main, 0.16)
	mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), color), Rotation = 90}, main)
	local stroke = mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 4, Color = color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.45), ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, main)
	viewport(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.02), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.44)})
	label(main, pet.Name, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.46), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.14)}, 2.5)
	label(main, "+" .. math.floor(pet.Boost * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄", {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.15, 0.6), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.11),
		TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 255, 150)}, 2.5)

	local on = copies(pet.Name)
	local canAdd = on < count
	local eb = smallButton(main, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.75), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.17)},
		canAdd and Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90), canAdd and "EQUIP" or "EQUIPPED")
	eb.Activated:Connect(function() if canAdd then send("equip", pet.Name) end end)
	if on > 0 then
		stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 90)
		stroke.Thickness = 6
		local x = smallButton(holder, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.26)},
			Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 80), "X")
		mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, x)
		x.Activated:Connect(function() send("unequip", pet.Name) end)
	end
	local badge = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 60), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.07), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.38, 0.17)}, holder)
	round(badge, 1)
	mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 3, Color = OUTLINE, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, badge)
	label(badge, "x" .. count, {Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.76, 0.76), TextColor3 = OUTLINE}, false)
	holder.Parent = petContent
end

refresh = function()
	for _, c in ipairs(petContent:GetChildren()) do
		if c:IsA("GuiObject") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	local order, any = 0, false
	for _, egg in ipairs(PetConfig.Eggs) do
		for _, pet in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
			order += 1
			local n = pets[pet.Name] or 0
			if n > 0 then any = true; card(order, pet, n) end
		end
	end
	if not any then
		label(petContent, "Open an egg to get your first pet! 🥚", {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)}, 3)
	end
	if tab == "Pets" then
		title.Text = ("PETS %d/%d"):format(#equipped, Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("PetSlots") or MAX)
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- HATCH ANIMATION
--------------------------------------------------
local overlay = mk("Frame", {Name = "HatchOverlay", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -80), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 80), Visible = false, ZIndex = 20}, gui)
local stage = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.47),
	Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.6), ZIndex = 21}, overlay)
mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {AspectRatio = 1}, stage)
local flash = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 25}, overlay)
local topText = label(overlay, "", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.12), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.07), ZIndex = 22}, 3)
local nameText = label(overlay, "", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.74), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.09), ZIndex = 22}, 4)
local subText = label(overlay, "", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.84), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.05), ZIndex = 22}, 3)

local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")

local playing = false
local function playHatch(eggId, petName, isNew)
	playing = true
	for _, c in ipairs(stage:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("ViewportFrame") then c:Destroy() end end
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	overlay.Visible = true
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	tween(overlay, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.45})
	tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = 18})

	-- the egg: a clone of the real egg model if possible
	local eggVp = mk("ViewportFrame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21,
		Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210), LightColor = WHITE, LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)}, stage)
	local eggModel = EggModels.create(eggId)
	eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
	eggModel.Parent = eggVp
	local _, size = eggModel:GetBoundingBox()
	local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
	cam.FieldOfView = 40
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, size.Y * 0.15, -math.max(size.X, size.Y) * 2.2), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	cam.Parent = eggVp
	eggVp.CurrentCamera = cam
	topText.Text = "Hatching..."

	-- shake harder and harder
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t0 < 1.6 do
		local k = (os.clock() - t0) / 1.6
		eggModel:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.sin(os.clock() * (18 + k * 30)) * (0.08 + k * 0.28)))
		task.wait()
	end

	-- pop!
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0
	tween(flash, 0.5, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	eggVp:Destroy()
	local pet = PetConfig.PetByName[petName]
	local color = pet and PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
	local vp, model = viewport(stage, petName, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 21})
	local popScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0.3}, stage)
	tween(popScale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	topText.Text = isNew and "NEW PET!" or "You hatched"
	topText.TextColor3 = isNew and Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 90) or WHITE
	nameText.Text = petName
	nameText.TextColor3 = color
	subText.Text = (pet and pet.Rarity or "") .. "  •  +" .. math.floor((pet and pet.Boost or 0) * 100 + 0.5) .. "% ❄"
	subText.TextColor3 = WHITE

	local t1 = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - t1 < 2.4 do
		model:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0, (os.clock() - t1) * 1.5, 0))
		task.wait()
	end
	tween(overlay, 0.3, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
	tween(blur, 0.3, {Size = 0})
	task.wait(0.3)
	popScale:Destroy()
	vp:Destroy()
	overlay.Visible = false
	topText.Text, nameText.Text, subText.Text = "", "", ""
	playing = false
end

local signs = {} -- [eggId] = {slots = {[petName] = {vp, scale}}}

-- black silhouette until discovered; `justFound` lights up with a pop
updateSigns = function(justFound)
	for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
		for name, slot in pairs(entry.slots) do
			local known = discovered[name] == true
			if known and name == justFound then
				slot.vp.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
				tween(slot.vp, 0.6, {ImageColor3 = WHITE})
				slot.scale.Scale = 1.35
				tween(slot.scale, 0.5, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
			else
				slot.vp.ImageColor3 = known and WHITE or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function makeSign(prompt)
	local part = prompt.Parent
	if not part then return end
	local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	while model and not PetConfig.EggById[model.Name] do model = model:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") end
	if not model then return end
	local egg = PetConfig.EggById[model.Name]
	local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	if pg:FindFirstChild("PetSign_" .. egg.Id) then return end
	local _, size = model:GetBoundingBox()

	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Name = "PetSign_" .. egg.Id
	bb.Adornee = part
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(270, 205)
	bb.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 + 4.8, 0)
	bb.MaxDistance = 1000
	bb.Enabled = false -- shown by the proximity loop below
	bb.LightInfluence = 0
	bb.ResetOnSpawn = false

	local frame = mk("Frame", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 30, 55), BackgroundTransparency = 1}, bb)
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)}, frame)
	-- Transparent outer panel; preserve pet tiles, text, odds and layout.
	label(frame, egg.Name:upper() .. "  •  " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(egg.Cost) .. " ❄", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 6), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 26)}, 2)

	local grid = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -44)}, frame)
	mk("UIGridLayout", {CellSize = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 78), CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6),
		HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder}, grid)

	local entry = {slots = {}, bb = bb, part = part, shown = false, scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 0}, frame)}
	for i, pet in ipairs(egg.Pets) do
		local color = PetConfig.Rarities[pet.Rarity] or WHITE
		local cell = mk("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = i}, grid)
		local tile = mk("Frame", {BackgroundColor3 = color, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58)}, cell)
		mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)}, tile)
		mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(color:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5), color), Rotation = 90}, tile)
		mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = 2.5, Color = OUTLINE}, tile)
		local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, tile)
		local vp = viewport(tile, pet.Name, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
		label(cell, pet.Chance .. "%", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 58), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)}, 2)
		entry.slots[pet.Name] = {vp = vp, scale = scale}
	end
	signs[egg.Id] = entry
	bb.Parent = pg
	updateSigns()
end

-- egg signs only show when you're close; they pop in and shrink away
local SHOW_DISTANCE = 25
local HIDE_DISTANCE = 30
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		for _, entry in pairs(signs) do
			if entry.bb and entry.part and entry.part.Parent then
				local dist = hrp and (hrp.Position - entry.part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
				if not entry.shown and dist < SHOW_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = true
					entry.bb.Enabled = true
					entry.scale.Scale = 0
					tween(entry.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				elseif entry.shown and dist > HIDE_DISTANCE then
					entry.shown = false
					local tw = tween(entry.scale, 0.2, {Scale = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
					tw.Completed:Connect(function()
						if not entry.shown then entry.bb.Enabled = false end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end)

local function tween(o, t, props, style, dir)
	local tw = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw

local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o

	if stroke ~= false then mk("UIStroke", {Thickness = stroke or 2.5, Color = DARK, LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round}, l) end
	l.Parent = parent
	return l

local function hex(parent, radius, color, z, name)
	local h = mk("Frame", {Name = name or "Hex", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(radius * SQ3, radius * 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z}, parent)
	for _, rot in ipairs({0, 60, 120}) do
		mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(radius * SQ3, radius),
			Rotation = rot, BackgroundColor3 = color, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z}, h)
	end
	return h
end
local function setHexColor(h, color, transparency)
	for _, r in ipairs(h:GetChildren()) do
		if r:IsA("Frame") then
			r.BackgroundColor3 = color
			if transparency then r.BackgroundTransparency = transparency end
		end
	end
end

local function hexPos(q, r)
	local s = R + GAP
	return Vector2.new(s * SQ3 * (q + r / 2), s * 1.5 * r)
end

local function makeTile(parent, n, pos, radius, colorAccent)
	local holder = mk("Frame", {Name = n.Id or n.Name, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(radius * SQ3, radius * 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 2}, parent)
	local scale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, holder)
	local glow = hex(holder, radius + 7, colorAccent, 2, "Glow")
	setHexColor(glow, colorAccent, 0.75)
	local border = hex(holder, radius, WHITE, 3, "Border")
	local fillGroup = mk("CanvasGroup", {Name = "Fill", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(radius * SQ3, radius * 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 4}, holder)
	local fill = hex(fillGroup, radius - 5, OWNED_FILL, 4, "FillHex")
	mk("UIGradient", {Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(175, 185, 205)), Rotation = 90}, fillGroup)
	-- icon slot (shown when the node has an Icon)
	local icon = mk("ImageLabel", {Name = "Icon", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.5), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Image = n.Icon or "", Visible = (n.Icon or "") ~= "", ZIndex = 5}, holder)
	local hasIcon = icon.Visible
	local name = text(holder, n.Name, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, hasIcon and 0.7 or 0.46),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, hasIcon and 0.22 or 0.34), TextWrapped = true, ZIndex = 6}, 2.5)
	local price = text(holder, "", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, hasIcon and 0.86 or 0.72),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.7, 0.16), TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90), ZIndex = 6}, 2.5)
	local hit = mk("TextButton", {Name = "Hit", Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.95, 0.8), ZIndex = 8}, holder)
	return {holder = holder, scale = scale, glow = glow, border = border, fill = fill, fillGroup = fillGroup, name = name, price = price, hit = hit, node = n}
end

local function clearBoard()
	for _, c in ipairs(board:GetChildren()) do
		if not c:IsA("UIScale") then c:Destroy() end
	end
	tiles = {}
	selected = nil
	card.Visible = false
end

local function fitBoard(tree)
 local view = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
 local minX, maxX, minY, maxY = 0, 0, 0, 0
 for _, n in ipairs(tree.Nodes) do
  local p = hexPos(n.Q, n.R)
  minX = math.min(minX, p.X - R); maxX = math.max(maxX, p.X + R)
  minY = math.min(minY, p.Y - R); maxY = math.max(maxY, p.Y + R)
 end
 local scale = math.clamp(math.min(view.X * 0.88 / (maxX - minX), view.Y * 0.59 / (maxY - minY)), 0.25, 1)
 boardScale.Scale = scale
 board.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -(minX + maxX) * scale / 2, 0.43, -(minY + maxY) * scale / 2)
end
local function openTree(tree)
	clearBoard()
	currentTree = tree
	title.Text = tree.Name .. " UPGRADES"
	title.TextColor3 = tree.Color
	backB.Visible = true
	completed.Visible = true
	board.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45)
	boardScale.Scale = 1
	for _, n in ipairs(tree.Nodes) do
		local t = makeTile(board, n, hexPos(n.Q, n.R), R, tree.Color)
		tiles[n.Id] = t
		t.hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(t.scale, 0.12, {Scale = 1.08}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
		t.hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(t.scale, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
		t.hit.Activated:Connect(function()
			selected = n
			refresh()
		end)
	end
	fitBoard(tree)
	refresh()
end

		local t = makeTile(board, {Name = tree.Name, Id = "Pick_" .. tree.Id}, Vector2.new((i - 2) * 270, 0), 115, tree.Color)
		setHexColor(t.fill, tree.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.25))
		t.name.TextSize = 40
		t.price.Text = done .. "/" .. #tree.Nodes
		t.price.TextColor3 = WHITE
		t.hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(t.scale, 0.12, {Scale = 1.06}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
		t.hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(t.scale, 0.12, {Scale = 1}) end)
		t.hit.Activated:Connect(function() openTree(tree) end)
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------
-- REFRESH
--------------------------------------------------
refresh = function()
	snowLabel.Text = "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(snow())
	if not currentTree then return end
	local set = ownedSet()
	local stages = stageSet()
	local done = 0
	for id, t in pairs(tiles) do
		local n = t.node
		local have = set[id]
		local avail = U.Available(n, set, stages)
		if have then done += 1 end
		if have then
			setHexColor(t.fill, n.Center and CENTER_FILL or OWNED_FILL)
			setHexColor(t.border, WHITE)
			t.glow.Visible = true
			t.fillGroup.GroupTransparency = 0
			t.name.TextTransparency = 0
			t.price.Text = ""
		elseif avail then
			setHexColor(t.fill, n.Center and CENTER_FILL or AVAIL_FILL)
			setHexColor(t.border, currentTree.Color)
			t.glow.Visible = false
			t.fillGroup.GroupTransparency = 0
			t.name.TextTransparency = 0
			t.price.Text = "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(U.CostOf(n))
			t.price.TextColor3 = snow() >= U.CostOf(n) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
		else
			setHexColor(t.fill, LOCK_FILL)
			setHexColor(t.border, Color3.fromRGB(70, 78, 98))
			t.glow.Visible = false
			t.fillGroup.GroupTransparency = 0.1
			t.name.TextTransparency = 0.45
			t.price.Text = (n.RequiredStage and n.RequiredStage ~= "Starter" and not stages[n.RequiredStage] and StageConfig.ById[n.RequiredStage]) and StageConfig.ById[n.RequiredStage].Name or ""
			t.price.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 180, 200)
		end
		t.holder.ZIndex = (selected == n) and 3 or 2
	end
	completed.Text = done .. "/" .. #currentTree.Nodes .. " Completed!"

	-- info card
	local n = selected
	card.Visible = n ~= nil
	if n then
		cardName.Text = n.Name
		cardName.TextColor3 = currentTree.Color
		cardDesc.Text = n.Text or ""
		local cost = U.CostOf(n)
		if set[n.Id] then
			buyText.Text = "OWNED ✓"
			buyB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 110, 150)
		elseif not U.Available(n, set, stages) then
			buyText.Text = "LOCKED"
			cardDesc.Text = U.LockReason(n, set, stages) or ""
			buyB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 95, 115)
		elseif snow() >= cost then
			buyText.Text = "BUY  ❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(cost)
			buyB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 200, 90)
		else
			buyText.Text = "❄ " .. NumberFormat.Abbreviate(cost)
			buyB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 70, 80)
		end
	end
end

local busy = false
buyB.Activated:Connect(function()
	local n = selected
	if busy or not n then return end
	busy = true
	buyScale.Scale = 0.9
	tween(buyScale, 0.3, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return buyRemote:InvokeServer(n.Id) end)
	busy = false
	if ok and res == true and tiles[n.Id] then
		local t = tiles[n.Id]
		t.scale.Scale = 1.3
		tween(t.scale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		-- neighbours that just became available pop a little
		task.delay(0.1, function()
			for _, nb in ipairs(U.Neighbours(n)) do
				local tt = tiles[nb.Id]
				if tt then
					tt.scale.Scale = 1.12
					tween(tt.scale, 0.35, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	refresh()
end)

-- PAN + ZOOM
--------------------------------------------------
local dragging, dragStart, boardStart
bg.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		boardStart = board.Position
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if not sg.Enabled then return end
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local d = input.Position - dragStart
		board.Position = UDim2.new(boardStart.X.Scale, boardStart.X.Offset + d.X, boardStart.Y.Scale, boardStart.Y.Offset + d.Y)
	elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and currentTree then
		boardScale.Scale = math.clamp(boardScale.Scale + input.Position.Z * 0.08, 0.25, 1.5)
	end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

local function open()
	sg.Enabled = true
	blur.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
	tween(blur, 0.25, {Size = 18})
	openPicker()
	refresh()
end
local function close()
	sg.Enabled = false
	tween(blur, 0.2, {Size = 0})
	clearBoard()
end
openButton.Activated:Connect(function()
	if sg.Enabled then close() else open() end
end)
exitB.Activated:Connect(close)
backB.Activated:Connect(openPicker)
script.Parent:WaitForChild("VillageOpenMenu").Event:Connect(function(name)
 if name == "Upgrades" then open() elseif sg.Enabled then close() end
end)
